label: copy-phase fed-back "3" when "y" is about to be output
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost only (98% of mass) when the fed-back input is the digit 3, i.e. when the model is reproducing an original 3 and the next output is the token that followed it. It is strongly gated by what comes next: activations are largest when the current output is y (3 followed by y in the original, about 67% of mass; top examples are all ...3 y...), and weaker when y is the output after that. With other following tokens (t, g, q, e, ...) it fires weakly or not at all. Also needs recall_idx >= 3 (the 3 sits at original position >= 2); a 3 earlier in the sequence rarely activates it. A small amount of weak activation comes from fed-back y inputs before another y. It never fires in the original or delimiter phase, or on first occurrences of a token. Missed activations are mostly weak 3-inputs followed by other tokens; false positives are 3-then-y cases where it stays silent.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=3 (+7.99), phase=2 & in_tok=y (+5.51), in_tok=3 (+3.79), phase=2 & out_tok=y (+3.11), next_out=y (+2.80), out_tok=y (+2.80). Lower it: recall_idx=1 (-3.50), prev_tok=<DEL> (-3.50), out_tok=w (-3.18), out_tok=o (-3.17).
